exposure: Not remembering the last normal menstrual period
cohort: 484 women who gave birth at public hospitals in the Sidama region of Ethiopia
finding: Factors associated with increased odds of caesarean birth included partograph monitoring, previous caesarean birth, genital cutting/mutilation, intermittent cardiotocography monitoring during childbirth, absence of companionship during delivery, and not remembering the last normal menstrual period.
